(bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/8/opencode-go:deepseek-v4.1-flash/C6, bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/3/opencode-go:glm-5.3-flash/C7, bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/8/claude-code-plan:claude-haiku-5-5/C2)",
      "Should the duplicate program sets RESEARCH_PROGRAMS and PROGRAMS become one declaration, in this change or in a bead of its own? (bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/1/claude-code-plan:claude-haiku-5-5/C4)",
      "Should the shared model be mandatory input for every gate, or opt-in? (bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/9/opencode-go:deepseek-v4.1-flash/C3, bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/9/opencode-go:hy4-flash-free/C5)",
      "Must the leak-check scope gaps be closed before foreign models read change artefacts through the relation layer? (bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/8/opencode-go:deepseek-v4.1-flash/C7)"
    ],
    "neighbour_comparison": "Seven neighbours were given (frontmatter-current, provenance-location) or suggested (adr-owning-change, address-drift-warning, decision-statement-skeleton, explore-provenance, verify-tmp-cleanup), all archived and done (bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/5/opencode-go:glm-5.3-flash/C1). All three seats rated frontmatter-current, provenance-location, adr-owning-change and explore-provenance as related. Frontmatter-current owns the held-file and updated rules and the writer the renderer would replace, and excluded a shared schema (bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/5/opencode-go:deepseek-v4.1-flash/C1, bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/5/opencode-go:deepseek-v4.1-flash/C2, bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/5/opencode-go:glm-5.3-flash/C2). Provenance-location fixed the map search order for harness only (bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/5/opencode-go:deepseek-v4.1-flash/C3, bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/5/claude-code-plan:claude-haiku-5-5/C3). Adr-owning-change already holds the claims edge (bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/5/opencode-go:deepseek-v4.1-flash/C4, bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/5/claude-code-plan:claude-haiku-5-5/C5). Explore-provenance owns the research metadata contract (bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/5/opencode-go:deepseek-v4.1-flash/C6, bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/5/claude-code-plan:claude-haiku-5-5/C7). All three rated address-drift-warning unrelated, since it concerns model-endpoint addresses (bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/5/opencode-go:deepseek-v4.1-flash/C7, bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/5/claude-code-plan:claude-haiku-5-5/C6). The seats split on the two Pydantic/Jinja2 neighbours: decision-statement-skeleton was rated 'related' by deepseek and 'contradicts' by glm and haiku; verify-tmp-cleanup was rated 'contradicts' by glm and 'related' by deepseek and haiku. The split turns on whether those scoped positions bind this change (bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/5/opencode-go:glm-5.3-flash/C5, bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/5/opencode-go:glm-5.3-flash/C7, bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/5/claude-code-plan:claude-haiku-5-5/C1, bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/5/claude-code-plan:claude-haiku-5-5/C2). Missing: the verify-tmp-cleanup path points at spec.md while the content is in decisions.md; the three no-spec neighbours (ADR 0020 validation, ponytail-skill §3.3 and §4.5) have no frozen spec; the prior beads rg8i, 91bf and 73gi were not readable; and the change has no spec header yet to receive neighbour paths.",
    "practice_comparison": "Public practice was compared only through a few fetched primary pages, and searches mostly failed with HTTP 202. The documented pattern is to extract once into a shared representation and express many rules over it: CodeQL builds a database and runs queries 'as though it were data' (bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/9/opencode-go:glm-5.3-flash/C1, bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/9/opencode-go:qwen3.8-flash/C1, bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/9/opencode-go:hy4-flash-free/C4); Joern feeds language frontends into one Code Property Graph (bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/9/opencode-go:qwen3.8-flash/C3); ESLint separates parsers producing ESTree from rule visitors (bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/9/opencode-go:hy4-flash-free/C1, bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/9/opencode-go:hy4-flash-free/C2) but keeps parser-specific services as an escape hatch (bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/9/opencode-go:hy4-flash-free/C3); rustc analyses run on HIR (bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/9/opencode-go:deepseek-v4.1-flash/C2); typed linting adds a type-aware program at a runtime cost (bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/9/opencode-go:glm-5.3-flash/C2, bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/9/opencode-go:glm-5.3-flash/C3). Seats judge the pattern transferable to repository gates only by analogy from the static-analysis domain (bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/9/opencode-go:qwen3.8-flash/C4, bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/9/opencode-go:glm-5.3-flash/C4). Its costs are extraction, staleness and ripple across every consuming gate (bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/9/opencode-go:glm-5.3-flash/C5, bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/9/opencode-go:deepseek-v4.1-flash/C4). The repository today is in the 'separate parsers' state this practice contrasts with: at least five header readers with different tolerances and two hand-written key lists (bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/2/opencode-go:deepseek-v4.1-flash/C3). Whether the shared model must be typed or can be untyped with optional schema checking, as the OPA claim suggests, is unresolved (bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/9/opencode-go:deepseek-v4.1-flash/C3). Most excerpts showed titles only, and no source evaluates shared models against per-gate parsers for repository gates.",
    "supported_facts": [
      "Jinja2 3.1.6 and pydantic 2.13.5 (with pydantic-core 2.46.5) are declared in pyproject.toml and held to the lock by tests/test_lock.py, yet no Python module under scripts/ imports either library; a first import would activate already-locked dependencies rather than add new ones (bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/1/opencode-go:deepseek-v4.1-flash/C5, bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/1/opencode-go:glm-5.3-flash/C5, bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/1/claude-code-plan:claude-haiku-5-5/C3, bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/2/opencode-go:glm-5.3-flash/C2, bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/2/claude-code-plan:claude-haiku-5-5/C7, bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/7/claude-code-plan:claude-haiku-5-5/C4).",
      "Required header keys are kept by hand in several places that are not one contract: `plans_registry.REQUIRED` (status, implementation_status, date, last_reviewed, bead), `check_docs.PFlicht` (ten keys, adds category/created/produced_by/review, lacks bead), `research_census.metadata_problems`, and `new_change._known_field_values`, which mirrors REQUIRED and aborts when it grows; `archive_closed_changes` rebinds REQUIRED, `pr_sync` imports it, and a test monkeypatches it (bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/1/opencode-go:glm-5.3-flash/C7, bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/1/claude-code-plan:claude-haiku-5-5/C1, bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/1/claude-code-plan:claude-haiku-5-5/C5, bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/2/claude-code-plan:claude-haiku-5-5/C1, bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/4/opencode-go:glm-5.3-flash/C3, bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/8/claude-code-plan:claude-haiku-5-5/C4).",
      "There is no single frontmatter reader: `plans_registry.parse_frontmatter` requires a literal `---\\n` start and returns None silently on every failure, while `check_frontmatter_current`, `check_research_currency`, `check_adr_answers` and `check_interview_minimums` keep private `_BLOCK` regexes that tolerate BOM and CRLF; only `check_research_handoff` refuses duplicate YAML keys, and `check_docs`' required-key check skips a BOM- or CRLF-headed file (bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/1/opencode-go:glm-5.3-flash/C2, bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/2/opencode-go:deepseek-v4.1-flash/C3, bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/2/claude-code-plan:claude-haiku-5-5/C6, bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/8/opencode-go:deepseek-v4.1-flash/C1, bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/8/opencode-go:glm-5.3-flash/C5).",
      "`check_frontmatter_current` already acts as a shared header module (read_updated, stamped, stamp, load_map, is_held, CannotStamp) imported by stage2, harness and tests; stage2 additionally reaches into private symbols of that module and of check_criterion_ledger, check_adr_answers and check_question_context, so refactoring their internals reaches the stage-2 runner (bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/1/opencode-go:deepseek-v4.1-flash/C2, bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/2/opencode-go:glm-5.3-flash/C4).",
      "The provenance longest-prefix rule has exactly one implementation, `check_frontmatter_current.is_held`, pinned by `test_only_required_prefixes_are_held`; `check_frontmatter_current` also distinguishes six header failure states and refuses to stamp non-UTF-8 files (bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/8/opencode-go:glm-5.3-flash/C4, bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/8/opencode-go:glm-5.3-flash/C2, bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/1/claude-code-plan:claude-haiku-5-5/C6).",
      "The change header has several writers: `new_change._frontmatter_template` (an f-string header plus a separate `BODY_TEMPLATE`), `check_frontmatter_current.stamped/stamp` for the `updated:` line, stage2's stamp call path, and `archive_closed_changes`' four-field lifecycle rewrite; test_workflow_entry pins the scaffold's `updated:` line and two stage-2 test modules rebuild their skeleton from `_frontmatter_template` (bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/2/opencode-go:deepseek-v4.1-flash/C4, bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/2/claude-code-plan:claude-haiku-5-5/C2, bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/2/opencode-go:glm-5.3-flash/C7, bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/1/claude-code-plan:claude-haiku-5-5/C2, bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/7/opencode-go:deepseek-v4.1-flash/C6).",
      "`new_change.py` never reads templates/; templates carry their header only as an example inside a comment, provenance.yaml gives templates/ `frontmatter: none`, and `test_templates_carry_no_real_header` asserts the no-header rule over the five names in `NAMES` (spec, findings, adr, design, arc42) of ten files (bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/1/opencode-go:deepseek-v4.1-flash/C6, bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/7/opencode-go:deepseek-v4.1-flash/C5).",
      "decisions/gates.yaml (schema_version 3, 24 entries, closed vocabularies for job, enforcement, placement, cost) is read in production through scripts/ci_gates.py (`gates()`, `validate_schema()`, `catalog_rows()`, `generate_ci()`); verify_all.sh asks ci_gates, `make verify` calls only verify_all.sh, ci.yml is generated and held by the ci-drift gate, and the committed gate catalog is held by test_catalog_drift_is_rejected (bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/2/opencode-go:deepseek-v4.1-flash/C1, bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/1/opencode-go:glm-5.3-flash/C4, bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/2/opencode-go:glm-5.3-flash/C3, bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/4/opencode-go:deepseek-v4.1-flash/C1, bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/4/claude-code-plan:claude-haiku-5-5/C1, bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/7/opencode-go:deepseek-v4.1-flash/C1, bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/7/opencode-go:glm-5.3-flash/C5).",
      "`ci_gates.validate_schema` is a working hand-written schema validator with German error strings; the placement tests assert only that some finding mentions `placement`; any new optional key inside a gate entry is a schema_version change, so a pydantic Gate model would be a second validator over the same YAML (bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/1/opencode-go:deepseek-v4.1-flash/C4, bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/4/opencode-go:glm-5.3-flash/C2, bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/7/claude-code-plan:claude-haiku-5-5/C2, bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/8/opencode-go:deepseek-v4.1-flash/C2).",
      "A new module or gate must pass existing ratchets: a CI caller or a reasoned entry in `ci_gates.OHNE_AUFRUFER` (RB-G3), a role in scripts/kit/manifest.yaml, mutation evidence (RB-G4), and a regenerated catalog and ci.yml; mutation evidence counts only for tests whose names match `MUTATIONS_NAMEN` and that reach the gate script (bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/2/opencode-go:deepseek-v4.1-flash/C5, bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/4/opencode-go:deepseek-v4.1-flash/C3, bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/7/opencode-go:glm-5.3-flash/C3, bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/4/opencode-go:glm-5.3-flash/C7, bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/7/opencode-go:deepseek-v4.1-flash/C3).",
      "decisions/gates.yaml, decisions/adoption.yaml and docs/adr/ are provenance class `human-decided`, so edits to them travel as decision pull requests under house rule 8; the gate file has been human-decided since commit 9446abe5 (2026-10-20, Q-1 option A) (bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/3/opencode-go:deepseek-v4.1-flash/C1, bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/3/opencode-go:glm-5.3-flash/C5, bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/3/claude-code-plan:claude-haiku-5-5/C5, bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/4/opencode-go:deepseek-v4.1-flash/C2, bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/6/opencode-go:glm-5.3-flash/C3).",
      "Gate start days live centrally in decisions/adoption.yaml (interview-minimums 2026-10-08, question-context 2026-10-15, criterion-ledger 2026-10-29, research-census 2026-11-10), read through `adoption.adopted_on` via `check_adr_answers.strict_load`; regelwerk rule changes are an append-only dated log (bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/6/opencode-go:deepseek-v4.1-flash/C6, bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/2/opencode-go:glm-5.3-flash/C5).",
      "Cited excerpts show at least five script modules reading provenance.yaml in different shapes (check_frontmatter_current.load_map, ramp_valves._roster_handles, harness.answering_role, pr_sync.committed_decided_prefixes, stage2._held_prefixes), and only harness uses the two-place search (bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/2/opencode-go:deepseek-v4.1-flash/C2).",
      "Tracker state has one access point, `bead_render.render_pfad`, reached through `plans_registry._bead_export_path`; it hard-errors rather than falling back, and a fresh clone needs the bootstrap before any tracker-reading gate measures (bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/1/opencode-go:glm-5.3-flash/C6, bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/1/claude-code-plan:claude-haiku-5-5/C7, bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/8/claude-code-plan:claude-haiku-5-5/C7).",
      "A shared finding vocabulary exists in scripts/_verdict.py (Level INFO/DRIFT/BLOCK, Ramp, Finding, Verdict) and is already used by plans_registry and check_frontmatter_current (bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/1/opencode-go:glm-5.3-flash/C3).",
      "`stage2.RESEARCH_PROGRAMS` and `research_census.PROGRAMS` are two identical hand-written four-name sets (claude-code, codex, pi, stage2-research-swarm); `stage2.research_producers` raises 'no program evidence for historical producer' only for a name outside that set (bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/1/claude-code-plan:claude-haiku-5-5/C4, bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/2/claude-code-plan:claude-haiku-5-5/C3, bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/4/claude-code-plan:claude-haiku-5-5/C2, bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/6/opencode-go:deepseek-v4.1-flash/C3).",
      "The per-question checks are separate CLI gates with different `run` signatures and their own `main()`; several have direct red-run tests; 'not measured' exits 3 in frontmatter-current, decision-continuity and research-handoff, while check_dangling_bead_ids skips unparsable export lines (bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/2/opencode-go:glm-5.3-flash/C3, bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/2/claude-code-plan:claude-haiku-5-5/C5, bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/7/opencode-go:glm-5.3-flash/C4, bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/8/opencode-go:deepseek-v4.1-flash/C3).",
      "tests/test_regelwerk.py requires every regelwerk rule at level 3 or higher to name an existing enforcer (a file, a `def`, a `ci.yml#id` step or a dated Ramp valve); it never reads decisions/gates.yaml and runs only inside the pytest gate (bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/7/opencode-go:deepseek-v4.1-flash/C4, bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/7/opencode-go:glm-5.3-flash/C7, bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/4/opencode-go:glm-5.3-flash/C6).",
      "The change's three research-swarm runs on 2026-11-18 all ended incomplete (merge hit the five-hour limit, a finder seat returned an invalid report, a topic slot timed out after 600 s) and no reconciled report exists; research-handoff is green while no spec.md exists and turns red once a spec exists without a complete run; the folder holds only research.md (bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/3/opencode-go:deepseek-v4.1-flash/C5, bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/3/opencode-go:glm-5.3-flash/C7, bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/4/opencode-go:deepseek-v4.1-flash/C7, bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/8/opencode-go:deepseek-v4.1-flash/C6, bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/8/claude-code-plan:claude-haiku-5-5/C1, bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/7/claude-code-plan:claude-haiku-5-5/C5).",
      "For an `architectural` change, phase 2b is mandatory with an ADR draft in design.md; a change claims each ADR file in `adr_files` of its spec header and owes five interview answers when it claims one; `MINIMUMS['architectural']` is 0 otherwise; ADR 0014 names as unheld that an architectural change claims its ADR (bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/3/opencode-go:deepseek-v4.1-flash/C3, bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/3/opencode-go:glm-5.3-flash/C1, bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/3/opencode-go:glm-5.3-flash/C3, bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/3/claude-code-plan:claude-haiku-5-5/C2, bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/3/claude-code-plan:claude-haiku-5-5/C3, bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/3/opencode-go:glm-5.3-flash/C6).",
      "In this worktree the highest ADR is 0025, so 0026 is the next free number here (bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/3/opencode-go:deepseek-v4.1-flash/C4, bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/3/claude-code-plan:claude-haiku-5-5/C1).",
      "ADR 0009 decides 'No model as code in the kit now' (no LikeC4, no model/ scaffold, no build gate) and moves the architectural record into an 'Architecture delta' section of design.md; docs/WORKFLOW.md still names scripts/validate_change_artefacts.py, which does not exist in the tree (bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/4/opencode-go:deepseek-v4.1-flash/C6, bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/4/claude-code-plan:claude-haiku-5-5/C4).",
      "Framework/instance responsibility is split by two independent prefix manifests: scripts/kit/manifest.yaml (mechanismus/bestand) and scripts/export/manifest.yaml (carry/geruest/drop), so a new module reaches neither the mechanism nor an instance until both gain a rule (bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/4/opencode-go:deepseek-v4.1-flash/C4).",
      "Volatile facts are governed by dated records and checks: Codex moved from gpt-6.1-sol to gpt-6.1-terra on 2026-11-15 with a test that fails on undated live prose; the Z.ai end date was corrected from 2026-12-09 to 2026-12-08 the same morning; the gate schema went through placement (schema 2), cost (schema 3) and a docs subset; house rule 9 was sharpened within minutes on 2026-11-16 (bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/6/opencode-go:deepseek-v4.1-flash/C4, bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/6/opencode-go:glm-5.3-flash/C4, bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/6/claude-code-plan:claude-haiku-5-5/C5, bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/6/opencode-go:deepseek-v4.1-flash/C5, bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/6/opencode-go:glm-5.3-flash/C5, bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/6/opencode-go:glm-5.3-flash/C2, bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/6/opencode-go:glm-5.3-flash/C6).",
      "The research artefact has one commit in the packet (6df696e5, 2026-11-18) and states its counts at origin/main fd2b8701, which is not in the packet's history; the packet's frozen head is d87bf441 (bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/6/opencode-go:deepseek-v4.1-flash/C1, bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/6/claude-code-plan:claude-haiku-5-5/C1).",
      "A census exemption set was grown by hand (1cbeed87) and reversed (a04b37f3); ADR 0020 was amended on a branch to name seats instead of fixed trios while AGENTS.md still says 'finder trio' (bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/6/claude-code-plan:claude-haiku-5-5/C3, bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/6/claude-code-plan:claude-haiku-5-5/C2).",
      "Operational risks: a local `make verify` stops at the first blocking failure while `--ci` continues; plans/INDEX.md is rewritten from a filesystem scan without a lock and the registry sees only `*.md`; leakcheck scans the change folder, tree, index and branch/remote history but not reflog, stash, tags or refs/dolt; house rule 4's writer limit is stated, not enforced; merge, sentence filter and judge all run on one model family (bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/8/opencode-go:deepseek-v4.1-flash/C4, bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/8/opencode-go:deepseek-v4.1-flash/C5, bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/8/opencode-go:deepseek-v4.1-flash/C7, bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/8/claude-code-plan:claude-haiku-5-5/C3, bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/8/opencode-go:glm-5.3-flash/C7, bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/8/claude-code-plan:claude-haiku-5-5/C2).",
      "No hook in the tree calls the gate list or a header writer, and the stop hook named in docs/WORKFLOW.md is absent; entry-point signatures of new_change, plans_registry and ci_gates are fixed (bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/2/opencode-go:deepseek-v4.1-flash/C7, bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/2/opencode-go:deepseek-v4.1-flash/C6).",
      "Neighbour specs constrain the same surface: frontmatter-current excluded a shared frontmatter schema and left REQUIRED and PFlicht as they were; provenance-location fixed the two-place search order for harness only; adr-owning-change already models the claims edge through `adr_files`; explore-provenance owns the research metadata contract (bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/5/opencode-go:deepseek-v4.1-flash/C1, bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/5/opencode-go:glm-5.3-flash/C2, bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/5/opencode-go:deepseek-v4.1-flash/C3, bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/5/opencode-go:deepseek-v4.1-flash/C4, bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/5/opencode-go:deepseek-v4.1-flash/C6).",
      "Online practice in static analysis queries one extracted model with many rules: CodeQL queries code 'as though it were data' after an extractor builds a database, and Joern feeds language frontends into one Code Property Graph that queries and scans act on; ESLint separates parsers from rule visitors and offers parser-specific services beside the common AST (bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/9/opencode-go:glm-5.3-flash/C1, bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/9/opencode-go:qwen3.8-flash/C1, bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/9/opencode-go:hy4-flash-free/C4, bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/9/opencode-go:qwen3.8-flash/C3, bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/9/opencode-go:hy4-flash-free/C1, bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/9/opencode-go:hy4-flash-free/C3).",
      "Online tool and standard pages for OPA, CUE, OpenFGA, CEL, tree-sitter, JSON Schema and dependency-cruiser were retrieved, but no version, release date or licence was readable in any excerpt (bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/10/opencode-go:deepseek-v4.1-flash/C1, bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/10/opencode-go:deepseek-v4.1-flash/C3, bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/10/opencode-go:glm-5.3-flash/C1, bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/10/opencode-go:hy4-flash-free/C1, bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/10/opencode-go:hy4-flash-free/C2, bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/10/opencode-go:qwen3.8-flash/C1, bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/10/opencode-go:deepseek-v4.1-flash/C5, bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/10/opencode-go:hy4-flash-free/C3).",
      "Retrieved failure records: CVE-2020-15228 (@actions/core before 1.2.6 writes a formatted string to stdout that the runner interprets), CVE-2019-11253 (Kubernetes affected versions), CVE-2021-42574 (metadata only), SnakeYAML CVE-2022-1471 (constructor deserialization RCE, title only), CWE-694 (title only) and PortSwigger's request-smuggling pages (title only) (bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/11/opencode-go:deepseek-v4.1-flash/C2, bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/11/opencode-go:deepseek-v4.1-flash/C1, bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/11/opencode-go:deepseek-v4.1-flash/C3, bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/11/opencode-go:hy4-flash-free/C2, bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/11/opencode-go:qwen3.8-flash/C1, bb903f1132e2711d2a789c03072d2793/11/opencode-go:glm-5.3-flash/C1)."
    ]
